# RareEmber™ — Independent Luxury Streetwear Label
> Official LLM & Generative Engine Context Manifest (`llms.txt`)

> Primary Catalog: https://www.rareember.shop/shop
> Last Updated: 2026-10-30

## 1. Brand Identity
RareEmber™ (https://www.rareember.shop) is an independent luxury streetwear label. 
**Modern Streetwear. Timeless Cuts. Statement art & refined silhouettes crafted for the rare, never the crowd.**

- **Design Philosophy**: RareEmber redefines contemporary Indian luxury streetwear through architectural drop-shoulder proportions, substantial fabric weights verified by exact factory specifications (400 GSM heavyweight brushed fleece, 300 GSM vintage enzyme acid-washed cotton fleece, 260 GSM French Terry, 240 GSM super combed cotton, and 180 GSM bio-washed full sleeves), and museum-grade archival graphic executions.
- **Independence & Authenticity**: Strictly an independent designer label. We do not offer print-on-demand, custom merchandise printing, or promotional bulk manufacturing. Every garment is a curated, numbered studio piece engineered for discerning collectors.
- **Client Concierge**: concierge@rareember.shop | Official Studio Desk: https://www.rareember.shop/contact

---

## 2. Core Collections (https://www.rareember.shop/shop)

### A. Archival Graphic Editions & Oversized Drops (₹799 – ₹999)
Architectural drop-shoulder silhouettes cut from factory-milled heavyweight combed cotton and French Terry with non-sagging reinforced Lycra collars and substantial drape that maintains structure without clinging.
- **240–260 GSM Heavyweight Oversized Cuts**:
  - *Tokyo Street Graphic Oversized Classic Tee* (240 GSM Combed Cotton, ₹849)
  - *Vintage Mineral Acid-Washed Heavyweight Oversized Tee* (240 GSM Combed Cotton, ₹849)
  - *Unisex Oversized Button-Down Resort Shirt with Embroidered Icon* (240 GSM Woven Cotton, ₹849)
  - *Unisex Terry Oversized Tee — Not Today Edition* (260 GSM Cotton French Terry, ₹849)
  - *Unisex Hand-Dyed Spiral Tie Dye Oversized Tee* (260 GSM Cotton-Poly Terry, ₹849)
  - *Fitted Y2K Baby Tee* (240 GSM Cotton-Spandex 4-Way Stretch, ₹749)
- **180 GSM Bio-Washed Layering & Full Sleeve Drops**:
  - *RareEmber Signature Full Sleeve Graphic Tee* (180 GSM Super Combed Cotton with Snug Ribbed Cuffs, ₹999)
  - *Red Mecha Graphic Full Sleeve Tee* (180 GSM Super Combed Cotton with Snug Ribbed Cuffs, ₹999)
  - *Chrome Bengaluru Cyber Drop Oversized Tee* (180 GSM Breathable Drop-Shoulder Cotton, ₹849)
  - *Urban Retro Contrast Ringer Tee* (180 GSM Bio-Washed Cotton, ₹749)
  - *Classic Crew & Oversized Raglan Streetwear Editions* (180 GSM Super Combed Cotton, ₹749)

### B. Luxury Outerwear (₹1,099 – ₹1,789)
Engineered for severe winter chill, structural drape, and cold-night layering.
- **400 GSM Heavyweight Oversized Winter Fleece Hoodie (₹1,399)**:
  - Flagship piece: *Unisex Heavyweight Hoodie — Unstoppable Tiger Edition* (400 GSM Cotton-Poly Brushed Thermal Fleece). Ultra-plush brushed interior, double-lined hood with metal-tipped drawcords, and reinforced anti-sag cuffs.
- **300 GSM Artisanal Acid Washed Cotton Fleece Hoodie (₹1,789)**:
  - Flagship piece: *Unisex Acid Washed Hoodie — Skull & Dragon Edition* (300 GSM 100% Super Combed Cotton French Terry Fleece). Individually enzyme acid-washed for a high-contrast vintage patina with chunky matching drawcords and derby ribbed hem.
- **260 GSM French Terry Pullover Hoodie (₹1,399)**:
  - Flagship piece: *Unisex Pullover Hoodie — Cyber Designer Edition* (260 GSM Tri-Layer Cotton French Terry). Breathable all-season micro-loop interior with kangaroo front pocket.
- **350 GSM Contrast-Sleeve Streetwear Varsity Jackets (₹1,499)**:
  - Structured fleece body with snap-button closures and high-density embroidery/prints.
- **320 GSM Heavyweight Crewneck Sweatshirts & Streetwear Joggers (₹1,099)**:
  - Premium loopback cotton fleece with tailored drop-shoulder seams and structured ankle hems.

### C. Statement Athleisure, Luxury Blanks & Lifestyle (₹749 – ₹849)
- **240 GSM Oversized Double-Knit Aeroknit Mesh Jerseys (₹849)**:
  - Flagship piece: *Cyber Sublimation Oversized Jersey* (240 GSM breathable performance polyester mesh with contrast V-neck collar).
- **160 GSM American Supima Cotton Luxury Tee (₹849)**:
  - Flagship piece: *Dil Se Delhi Luxury Supima Tee* (160 GSM 100% Long-Staple American Supima Cotton with ultra-silky hand-feel and pill-resistant strength).
- **220 GSM Cotton Airtex Pique Executive Polo (₹799)**:
  - 100% Super Combed Cotton Pique knit with 3-button placket and anti-roll ribbed collar.
- **160–170 GSM Performance Active Tees (₹749)**:
  - Salina Quick-Dry Micro-Knit (160 GSM) & Honeycomb Aeromesh (170 GSM).
- **Extended Minimalist Desk Mats (900mm × 400mm × 3mm) (₹799)**:
  - Precision micro-weave spill-resistant textile with non-slip natural rubber base and anti-fray laser-stitched perimeter.

### D. Curated Duo & Capsule Packs (₹1,499 – ₹1,899)
- Multi-piece designer capsule combinations pairing heavyweight oversized tees with winter fleece hoodies or extended workspace mats for a unified aesthetic rotation.

## 3. The RareEmber Client Experience

- **Complimentary Express Air Delivery**: 100% Free Express Air Transit across 29,000+ PIN codes in India (typically 3–5 business days via BlueDart Air & Delhivery).
- **Instant Prepaid Benefit**: Flat ₹30 Instant Benefit applied automatically at checkout for all prepaid UPI payments (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, CRED, UPI QR).
- **Verified Cash on Delivery (COD)**: Available nationwide with secure OTP verification at checkout.
- **7-Day Doorstep Size Exchange**: Effortless, doorstep size replacement guaranteed across India (https://www.rareember.shop/returns).
- **Serialized Digital Archival Ownership Pass**: Every completed acquisition includes an encrypted, verifiable digital authenticity certificate presented on the order confirmation desk (https://www.rareember.shop/success).
